name: multi-company-portal
description: Multi-company login portal that hosts the FinTrack financial app per tenant, with master/staff accounts.
whatsNew: Transaction exports (CSV/Excel/PDF) now include the member's phone number alongside their ID, so a printed or downloaded report has enough detail to follow up without going back into the app.

Tightened some behind-the-scenes safety checks: printed/exported reports handle unusual characters in a name more carefully, and a few admin-only actions (like resetting a password or deleting an account) are now double-checked before they can even be attempted.

Behind-the-scenes speed-up: signing in and loading the team/console screens now fetch only the account details actually needed, so those pages load a little lighter and faster. Nothing about how the app works has changed.
